notes.title: The ART of Five Nights At Stickman
notes.content: [h1]THE ART:[/h1][p][/p][h1]UI:[/h1][p][/p][p]The UI is ofcourse very much inspired by FNAF 1,[/p][p]The visual assets of the camera button, the doors, the power buttons.[/p][p]I'd say the 2 biggest differences is the way the office looks and the red flashing lights during gameplay.[/p][p][/p][h1]AUDIO:[/h1][p][/p][p]The audio design is minimalistic, but haunting enough to shiver thy timbers.[/p][p][/p][p]It's hard to compare it to FNAF 1, as nearly all sounds are different in approach.[/p][p][/p][h1]CAMERA LOCATIONS & STICKMEN:[/h1][p][/p][p]Ofcourse the BIG thing that sets it a little apart.[/p][p][/p][p]We have the inky art at each camera location, and the bright coloured stickmen in those locatrions.[/p][p][/p][p]This makes the colour difference very....alien? The stickman feel out there, because...they are.[/p][p][/p][p](they are also in your walls)[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: From Biorage to Stickman
notes.content: [h1]HOW DID WE GET HERE?[/h1][p][/p][p]Biorage was an old school FPS, Five Nights At Stickman is a satirical FNAF fangame.[/p][p][/p][p]My actual original plans predate the cancelled BitBox title![/p][p][/p][p]I was planning on sticking to first person shooters, however, after messing around with a potential new and different FPS, I kinda felt meh about it.[/p][p][/p][p]Then came BitBox which did have an FPS as one of it's minigames. But in general bitbox was a major step in a different direction.[/p][p][/p][p]Then came FNAS, a wild idea I had in my head out of nowhere, and I kinda....loved it. SImple, but fun, really fun to make personally for me![/p][p][/p][p]I WILL likely do FPS again in the future, but just not now.[/p]

notes.title: The cancelled game: BitBox
notes.content: [h1]What WAS BitBox?[/h1][p][/p][p]BitBox was originally supposed to be the game that releases august 1st. [/p][p][/p][p]But what IS BitBox? BitBox was a 15 minigame collection, it had racing, horror, stories, survival etc.[/p][p][/p][p]Sadly, after technical issues with the Steam testers, and some installscript issues, the game got cancelled.[/p][p][/p][p]Kinda sad as it was an entire game ofcourse. But alas. This led me to FNAS. [/p][p][/p][h1]Is it lost media?[/h1][p][/p][p]I'm afraid so. Perhaps one day I can put it on itch.io, but the technical issuess might persist.[/p][p][/p][p]I CAN give you 2 things.[/p][p][/p][p]The logo (as seen in this post)[/p][p][/p][p]The descriptions of the minigames: [/p][p][/p][h3]🎮 Featured Minigames:[/h3][p][b]Demon Slayer[/b] – A wave-based arena shooter where enemy spawns are randomized. Rack up high scores and survive the onslaught.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Spike Race[/b] – Race against AI in fast-paced, procedurally generated environments—complete with unexpected random events like rain... or giraffes.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Lunar Watcher[/b] – A mysterious, story-driven exploration on the moon. Collect anomalies and uncover fragments of lore... but be warned—[b]you’re not alone[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Meltdown[/b] – You're trapped in a submarine with an unstable reactor. Keep things under control and chat with crewmates—if you can.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Dragon Boss Fight[/b] – Face off against [b]three dragons[/b], each with randomly chosen attacks. Dodge, strike, and survive the chaos.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Cube Field[/b] – An experimental playground where dynamic cubes react to your mouse—and your microphone.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Cave-In[/b] – You're trapped in a collapsing cave. Collect lore fragments and try to escape before everything crumbles around you.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Gardening[/b] – Harvest fruits to gain strange abilities like high jumps, speed boosts, shrinking, first-person view... and possibly encounter some [i]very determined snails[/i].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Case Opener[/b] – Open loot cases packed with weapons across four rarity tiers. Simple, satisfying, addictive.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Biorage Win/Lose[/b] – A chance-based game tied to the developer’s previous title, [i]Biorage[/i]. Win something... or don’t.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Make Them Happy[/b] – You [i]will[/i] make them happy... [b]or else[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Overthinker[/b] – A personal, emotional story-driven experience.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Tank & Balls[/b] – A tactical tank shooter with bouncing, blocking balls that change how every round plays out. Outsmart the AI across dynamic maps.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Knight Parkour[/b] – Brutally hard 2D platforming. The only way is up—but the higher you go, the more intense the fall.[/p][p][/p][p][b]3v3 Warfare[/b] – A team-based 3v3 shooter with randomly selected maps and weapons. First team to 15 points wins—good luck.[/p]

notes.title: Five Nights, Zero Chill.
notes.content: [h1]What exactly are the stickmen up to?[/h1][p][/p][p]Well well well, we have 4 stickmen.[/p][p][/p][olist][*][p][b]Eclipse[/b], this googly boogly has long tentacle like structure, it's calm most of the time, but when he gets mad......you wish you were dead.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Omega[/b], this box of a stickman is a bit quirky at times, it likes the left side a lot...it's not shy from cameras and will sometimes try to pose or show off his BOXY structure. [/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Silver[/b], this blue weirdo has floating eyes, nobody really knows why or how, he's also a bit goofy at times but more serious compared to his other stickmen.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p] [b]Flapper[/b], he be flapping[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p] [b][i][u]"REDACTED: REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED REDACTED[/u][/i][/b][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Phone call man[/b], he be calling you every night, giving you neat tips and threatening you kindly.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]You[/b], you are someone with a past, you are someone familiar, yet what you seek only lies at the end of your journey.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h1]Meet the office[/h1][p][/p][p]The gameplay is classic FNAF1.[/p][p][/p][p]You have 2 doors, limited power, some lights to shine if a stickman is at the door, many cameras.[/p][p][/p][p]You have to survive. Trust me, you do not want to fail. The stickmen have.....a way with...defeated nightguards.[/p][p][/p][p]Let's just hope you don't like spaghettification...[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Why did I choose stickmen?
notes.content: [h3]I truly worked [b]billions of hours[/b] to create these stickmen.[/h3][p][/p][h3][/h3][h3]The inspiration came to me on a random day at a random time. [/h3][p][/p][h3][/h3][h3]Like the great Freddy Fazbear once said "It is time for [b]stickman[/b]".[/h3][p][/p][h3][/h3][h3]From that moment....nothing was the same. and the Stickmen [b]came to life[/b].[/h3][p][/p][h3][/h3][h3]I'm happy to share this experience with y'all. It will change anyone daring [/h3][h3]enough to play it.[/h3][p][/p][h3][/h3][h3]"visible representation of people who played": 😀 -> 💀[/h3][p][/p][h3][/h3][p][/p]
